tokens.name: sky-0
tokens.usage: Void black: the top of the hero, the archive, the footer and the end of every gradient. Every text token reads on it.

tokens.name: sky-1
tokens.usage: Near black; the middle stop of the hero gradient and the body of sections below the clouds.

tokens.name: sky-2
tokens.usage: Graphite; the lightest dark ground text sits on with every text token.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Mid steel grey: the horizon glow behind the moon and the middle step of every hard gradient.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Silver light: the bright end of the hard gradients (the footer under the wordmark). Backgrounds only; text never sits on it.

tokens.name: cloud-floor
tokens.usage: The colour of the clouds’ underside, where the gradient below the cloud divider starts. ink and ink-2 read on it; ink-3 does not.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted panel fill (timer cards, live feed, start form). Always paired with backdrop blur `blur-glass` and a `line` border.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Drawers and modals: transcripts, transcript preview, notebook.

tokens.name: silver-hi
tokens.usage: Top highlight of the metal gradient on the primary button.

tokens.name: silver-mid
tokens.usage: Body of the metal gradient on the primary button.

tokens.name: silver-lo
tokens.usage: Lower band of the metal gradient on the primary button (the "bevel").

tokens.name: glass-liquid-hi
tokens.usage: Lit top-left of liquid glass (timer cards, live feed): a light sheen, never a solid fill.

tokens.name: glass-liquid-lo
tokens.usage: Body of liquid glass.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Edge and inner top highlight of liquid glass.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, table rows, dividers. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: input underlines, glass button borders, table header rule, history spine. 3:1 on sky-0 to sky-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on sky-0, sky-1, sky-2, cloud-floor, glass and glass-strong; the primary button fill; the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on every dark ground, glass and cloud-floor: field labels, nav links, metadata.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on sky-0 to sky-2 and glass (not on cloud-floor or silver): short task ids, placeholders, the cancelled state.

tokens.name: ink-fade
tokens.usage: Transparent end of the footer wordmark's vertical fade.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent, and it means live time: lit clock segments, the live pip, running glow, notebook ink. A fill, never small text.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal as small text (the word Running, running states in the feed and history) on sky-0 to sky-2 and glass.

tokens.name: signal-dim
tokens.usage: Segments warming up during the clock's boot sequence; the pip while connecting.

tokens.name: signal-ghost
tokens.usage: Unlit seven-segment ghosts; the brief flash behind a new live feed line.

tokens.name: signal-haze
tokens.usage: Bloom around lit segments. Only inside glows and shadows, never a fill.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: Moon highlights, the finished state (as text on any sky stop), the lit part of the moon-phase glyph.

tokens.name: moon-mid
tokens.usage: Placeholder moon mid-tone until the real photograph is supplied.

tokens.name: moon-shade
tokens.usage: Placeholder moon limb shade.

tokens.name: moon-shadow
tokens.usage: Unlit part of the moon-phase glyph.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Cloud highlights in imagery only. Never UI text or fills.

tokens.name: cloud-haze
tokens.usage: Faint haze where no cloud image is used.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Error text only (form validation, a failed cancel), on every sky stop and glass. Amber, so red keeps meaning time.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Footer wordmark only; scale it with the viewport (about 28vw) and crop it at the bottom edge. Width 125%.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Empty states, sheet headlines on phones. Width 125%.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Timer names, panel and sheet titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Every timer is shared with everyone watching.
styles.usage: The hero lead line, input values.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Start one, watch it count down, cancel it if you change your mind.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, buttons, nav.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, metadata, feed lines, ids. Sentence case, never uppercase or tracked.

styles.name: readout
styles.sample:
## You
I'm making a simple project, frontend + backend.
styles.usage: Transcript previews only (`ms-crt`), the one retro console on the site. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: id under a name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to input, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Feed and history column gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; card row gaps; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; desktop grid gutter; gaps between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; nav item spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the transcript note box.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Glass panels: timer cards, live feed, start form.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Drawers and modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The moon and the phase glyph only.

tokens.name: glow-card
tokens.usage: A running timer card: a red edge along the bottom and light spilling under it.

tokens.name: glow-pip
tokens.usage: The live indicator's segment.

tokens.name: rim-signal
tokens.usage: Red rim light on a drawn moon. The moon photograph already carries it.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind every glass surface.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: History expand, drawer slide.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Card enter and exit.

tokens.name: dur-boot
tokens.usage: The hero clock's boot sequence, start to finish.

tokens.name: ease-drift
tokens.usage: Every transform and fade. Stepped timing only for segment blinks.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Strength of the hard film grain laid over the whole page (`Grain`).
